anchor_rule: latest accepted observation at or before release_ts; anchor must be no more than 60 seconds stale
attachment_route: local automation/build_presignal_v21_episode_outcomes_v1_1.py -> endpoint_request -> Apps Script apiFetchGovernedHistoricalUsdJpyObservation -> immutable local outcome_rows.jsonl; later evaluation attaches one validated Outcome by episode_id/outcome_id
duplicate_prevention: unique outcome_id and duplicate reconciliation in build_outcomes; append-only local evidence; no overwrite of frozen forecast evidence
google_reads_next_move: 3 maximum Apps Script read/invocation calls for first 12-Episode slice, one per required UTC day, before provider-attempt accounting
historical_cutoff_rule: forecast cutoff precedes release and is preserved; Outcomes use release_ts as market anchor authority
horizon_measurement: close price at accepted observation at or before target, within 60 seconds; pips=(price-anchor)/0.01 rounded to 2 decimals; direction via direction_for_pips
immediate_impulse: additive supplement only; current one-minute route yields APPROXIMATION_ONLY rather than strict sub-minute support; T through T+120 seconds
market_closure_rules: no explicit closure substitution; missing observations remain unavailable
market_data_source_authority: existing Apps Script apiFetchGovernedHistoricalUsdJpyObservation route; provider order tiingo, eodhd, massive, twelvedata; one-minute OHLC, accepted price field close
missing_tick_rules: missing or stale anchor/horizon yields UNAVAILABLE/failed attachment; no imputation
price_side: close OHLC field only; bid/ask/midpoint not established
